opportunities.title: Agent Engineer
opportunities.description: The distance between an AI system that works and one that millions of people rely on every day is where the real engineering lives. Crossing it is what Agent Engineers at Sarvam do. The agents you build go into live operation at India's largest banks, insurers, NBFCs and government departments, and at some of the country's fastest-growing companies, handling millions of real interactions, measured against outcomes the customer wants to drive. The hard part is not the first version. It is everything after: mapping the full space of what an agent has to handle so the scenarios that matter are covered by design rather than discovered in production, engineering for the failure modes instead of the happy path, and building the evals and instrumentation that make quality measurable, so drift surfaces in the data rather than in a customer escalation. We treat agents as code. Not prompts someone tweaks in a console, but engineered artifacts: versioned, reviewed, and held to a regression suite, where you can reason about what a change will do and roll it back if you are wrong. Anyone who has watched an AI system quietly decay because nobody could tell which change broke it understands why this matters. And then doing it again for the next customer, faster, because you built the first one to be repeatable. About Sarvam Sarvam is India's leading full-stack AI company, building sovereign AI infrastructure and applications purpose-built for India. Headquartered in Bengaluru and founded by leading AI researchers, Sarvam builds foundational models for Indian languages, enterprise AI platforms, and voice-first AI agents that serve hundreds of millions of Indians. Sarvam is backed by top-tier investors and works with national and state governments, large enterprises, and developers across the country. We are building the AI layer for a billion people. What this role promises you Production, at real scale Not prototypes, not demos. Systems in live operation at some of India's largest institutions, carrying real volume, measured against outcomes the customer has signed up to. You will see the consequences of your engineering decisions within days. You work at the source Sarvam builds the whole stack: the foundational models, the infrastructure they run on, and the products on top of them. When a deployment needs something that does not exist yet, whether that is model behaviour, an infrastructure capability or a product change, you are not filing a ticket with a vendor and waiting on a roadmap. You are in a room with the people who built it. Anyone who has delivered AI on top of someone else's black box knows how much difference that makes. A genuinely broad surface Sarvam's products span conversational AI, agentic workflows, intelligent document processing, and content, including dubbing and document translation. You will own a motion and go deep in it, and the depth you build travels well as products mature and new ones ship. What you'll do Build production agents on the Sarvam stack: prompts, system design, workflows, tool integrations, and evals. Map the space the agent has to cover. Work out the scenarios that matter, how each should be handled, and where the edges are, so coverage is designed rather than discovered later. Build the proof of concept when a customer wants to see it work before committing at scale, and get to a convincing result fast. Integrate into systems that were never designed for this: core banking, CRM, ticketing, telephony, and whatever else the customer runs. Own quality end to end. Define what good means for the use case, build the evals that measure it, and close the gap until the numbers hold. Engineer agents like software. Version them, review them, and hold them to a regression suite, so quality does not depend on who last edited a prompt. Tune for the constraints that decide whether a system survives production: accuracy, cost, reliability, and performance under real load. Design for scale and consistency from the outset. Systems that behave the same on the hundred-thousandth interaction as the first, and that are instrumented well enough for anyone to see when they are not. Take a proven pattern into a new customer and make it fit their environment, at pace and at quality. At senior levels, own the technical build playbooks and the technical quality bar for a motion, and bring partner engineers up to it. Who you are We are hiring across levels, from 3+ years of experience. What matters more than years is whether you have built something real users depended on and kept it working. You have shipped to production and owned it afterwards. Not just built it. Kept it running, fixed it at 11pm, and let real usage change your assumptions. You have worked with LLMs and agents seriously. Context engineering, tool use, structured outputs, memory, and the failure modes that only show up at scale. You have used agentic frameworks and both open and closed source models. You bring engineering discipline to AI. You think in versions, tests, regressions and reproducibility. You are uncomfortable when a system's behaviour depends on a prompt nobody can account for. You take evals seriously. You can define metrics that matter for a use case, build the pipeline, and tell the difference between a real signal and noise. Strong Python and range across the stack. Backend services, data pipelines, APIs, cloud infrastructure. When you meet an unfamiliar stack you pick it up in hours. You design for the long run. You build systems that hold their behaviour over months, not just on launch day: predictable under real load, instrumented so problems are visible, and structured so someone else can reason about them. You can sit with a customer's engineering team. Understand their constraints, explain yours, and get to a workable answer without either side losing patience. Sarvam is committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment regardless of background, identity, or personal characteristics. We believe the best AI for India can only be built by a team that reflects India.

It protects surfaces like Commerce, Stock, and Firefly with real-time risk decisions. As a Sr Staff Engineer on ARP, you'll set the architectural direction for risk mitigation across Adobe. You'll define the standards, patterns, and long-term technical strategy that let ARP and Adobe stay ahead of fraud and abuse as it evolves. What you'll do Architect systems built for the next three to five years of risk mitigation, while delivering impact iteratively and solving today's most important priorities along the way. Push the platform to the forefront of AI and ML to strengthen fraud and abuse detection. Lay the foundational building blocks of the Risk Platform that future risk-mitigation capability builds on, including the platform's shift toward event-driven, continuously-reasoning risk intelligence. Set architectural standards for risk-decisioning services that other teams across Adobe adopt. Share architectural thinking broadly, through design docs that become org-wide standards, white papers, tech talks, or cross-org design reviews. Simplify complex, interlinked systems into designs other teams can build on with confidence. Mentor senior and staff engineers across teams, growing the next generation of technical leaders. What you need to succeed Bachelor's or advanced degree in Computer Science or related field, or equivalent experience; Master's preferred. 12+ years architecting high-scale, highly performant platforms, and leading the technical teams that build them. Deep understanding of AI and ML, both to strengthen fraud detection and to counter AI-powered attacks. Deep expertise in distributed systems and databases, including SQL, NoSQL, and DynamoDB-class stores. Track record architecting systems with multi-year relevancy, not just solving today's scaling or reliability problem. Experience with data lakes and large-scale data platforms like Databricks or Spark. Proven ability to influence engineering direction across teams and Business Units without formal authority. A track record of publishing or presenting technical work that shaped how others build. Nice to have Experience with graph databases or identity/relationship graphs applied to fraud or abuse detection (e.g., detecting rings, relay networks, or coordinated account abuse via graph traversal). Device fingerprinting or AI agent design experience. A payments, commerce, or fraud background. Familiarity with regulatory and compliance constraints relevant to payments and fraud decisioning (e.g., PCI, regional payment regulations). opportunities.title: Head of Design, Adobe Creative
opportunities.description: Our Company Empowering everyone to create. Adobe empowers everyone, everywhere to imagine, create and bring digital experiences to life. From creators and students to small businesses, global enterprises and nonprofit organizations, customers choose Adobe products to create, collaborate, grow, and build remarkable experiences. We are looking for curious, ambitious makers who want to help define world-class creativity in this new era. We believe the craft is more essential than ever while AI should help people create more, explore more, and unlock new possibilities while keeping creators at the center of the creative process. Adobe is amplifying human ingenuity with AI. Our Team Adobe Creative is Adobe’s in-house brand-creative engine, developing the ideas, campaigns, and assets that power Adobe’s brand and business. We are part of the broader Content & Creative (“C&C”) organization. We work alongside Adobe Content, which focuses on publishing and audience development through owned, earned, and partner channels; an Experiences team, which oversees Adobe’s real-world moments; and shared service teams spanning Video, Talent, Partnerships, and Production. Together, C&C commissions and produces work while equipping teams across Adobe’s Global Marketing Organization and the company to create, adapt, and distribute high-quality work with greater speed and consistency. The Opportunity Adobe makes the tools the world uses to create. Our own creative work should set the standard for what those tools make possible. Adobe Creative is looking for a visionary Head of Design to define design excellence for Adobe and build the practice, systems and culture that bring it to life across everything we create. You will lead design across our creative, content and experiences, from high-velocity everyday work to major global campaigns, product launches and Adobe’s most visible moments. You will raise the quality of the work at every scale, creating greater coherence without making it repetitive or predictable. Working upstream, you will establish the principles, frameworks, and practices that help teams make stronger design decisions earlier. You will translate them into tools, templates, and AI-enabled workflows that help internal teams and external partners deliver exceptional work at scale. The Head of Brand owns Adobe’s identity architecture and core brand system. You own the design practice and creative expression across the work, ensuring the brand is interpreted and brought to life with exceptional craft, intelligence and imagination. Design leadership at Adobe extends beyond traditional graphic design. It includes typography, image-making, art direction, motion, digital behavior, spatial experience, editorial thinking, emerging technology, and the creative use of AI. You are a maker first. You remain close to the tools, the teams, and the work. Your authority comes from your eyes , your judgment, and your ability to make the work better. What You’ll Do Set the Standard and Build the Practice Define and hold the design craft standard across Adobe Creative. Establish a clear point of view on world-class design in the age of AI. Build shared principles for typography, image-making, art direction, motion, interaction and emerging visual practices. Raise the design standard across everything we make, from high-velocity work to our most visible global moments. Ensure the work feels connected and recognizably Adobe without becoming repetitive or formulaic. Build frameworks, tools, and working practices that enable strong design decisions from the start. Partner with the Head of Brand to translate Adobe’s identity system into distinctive and adaptable creative expression. Partner with Production, Operations and Creative Technology to protect craft while supporting speed and scale. Lead Design Across the Work Lead design from early creative development through final execution. Set the art direction and design craft across Adobe’s creative, content and experiences. You will own E2E ML workflows including AI-driven agentic workflows with Gemini/Claude/Muse as well as scaled solutions through data analysis, feature engineering, model development and deployment.

opportunities.title: Research Scientist Intern, Scam and Trust (PhD)
opportunities.description: Meta was created to foster connection and sharing worldwide. Over the past decade, our platforms have transformed global communication. With over a billion active users, joining Meta provides extraordinary opportunities to make a meaningful impact within a rapidly evolving organization. Meta is seeking Research Scientist Interns to join our Scam and Trust team within Facebook. Scams are a global financial threat. At Meta’s scale, proactive detection and prevention are essential for protecting billions of users worldwide, making addressing scams one of the top priorities at Meta. The space is highly adversarial as bad actors continually change tactics and operate across content, behavior, and social networks, making isolated signals and static models insufficient. You will develop novel modeling and evaluation methods that address these challenges. You will work alongside research scientists and engineers to translate a real-world scam-detection and prevention challenge into a focused research project. Research opportunities include combining large language model (LLM) reasoning with actor representations and content or behavioral signals, and developing agentic systems that use tools to gather evidence, investigate suspicious activity, and adapt their reasoning. You may also investigate recursive self-improvement methods that enable LLM-based systems to identify weaknesses, propose improvements to their strategies or workflows, and validate those improvements through rigorous evaluation. Other research opportunities include learning from noisy and limited labels, transferring methods across surfaces, and maintaining robustness under distribution shift as adversaries evolve. Promising research may inform production systems that protect people from scams and contribute to research publications. Our internships are twelve (12) to sixteen (16), or twenty-four (24) weeks long and we have various start dates throughout the year.

Youth safety is one of the most consequential problems at Meta right now — the models you build change what millions of teenagers see every day. Our team owns age-appropriate content experiences across Facebook, including content-understanding and age-understanding models that decide what gets shown and to whom, spanning Teen Accounts, parental supervision, U13 experiences (Messenger Kids), and our most protective content tiers. More concretely, you will work on high-ambiguity, high-impact problems at the intersection of ML, integrity, and personalization: proactive detection of harmful content for youth, age-appropriate ranking and retrieval, safety-aware personalization and controls, and age-signal modeling (stated vs. predicted age reconciliation). A cross-cutting theme is evaluation at scale — building LLM-judge and quality-eval infrastructure so enforcement LLMs ship with rigorous, youth-specialized measurement, and connecting model improvements to real teen experience through human judgments and online experiments. Our internships are twelve (12) to sixteen (16), or twenty-four (24) weeks long and we have various start dates throughout the year.

opportunities.description: Meta was built to help people connect and share, and over the last decade our tools have played a critical part in changing how people around the world communicate with one another. In the pursuit of personal superintelligence, Meta's AI systems are becoming more capable, and evaluating their safety is critical. Meta is seeking Research Interns to join our Safety Evals and Red Teaming team within the Products and Applied Research org. We are seeking individuals passionate in areas such as Agent Safety, Benchmarks and Evaluations, Synthetic Data Generation, Automated Red teaming, LLM-as-a-Judge, benchmark design, eval harnesses, prompt injection, agent environments. What You Could Work On: Depending on your interests and the team’s priorities, a project could address questions such as: • How reliably do LLM-based judges identify safety-policy violations across different tasks, prompts, and adversarial conditions? Which environments and attack scenarios expose failures that simpler tests miss? • Which automated red teaming methods uncover meaningful safety failures, and how well do those failures generalize beyond the prompts or environments used to find them? • How can we use synthetic data and benchmark design to improve coverage while checking that scores reflect the behavior we intend to measure?
